_meta.purpose: Explicit, auditable provider team-name aliases. Keys are normalized provider names (lowercase, diacritics stripped, '&' -> 'and', punctuation removed). Values are canonical display names used by the historical canonical dataset.
_meta.source: Derived from real OddsPapi /v4/fixtures participant names (data/cache/oddspapi_pl_fixtures.json) and real canonical matches (data/golden/europe/canonical_matches.jsonl). No fuzzy or automatic alias generation.
_meta.policy: Only genuine presentation differences (club suffixes, abbreviations, punctuation) may be aliased. Ambiguous names must stay unmapped.
